target: Si Potestatem Habes, Utere Ea

source: 599 If You Have “Power,” Use It
target: Si Potestatem Habes, Utere Ea

source: Lumian didn’t hurry Lugano.
target: Lumian Lugano non festinavit.

source: He preferred to observe the Doctor’s decision-
target: Praeoptavit consilium medici observare.

source: making.
target: (Implicit in the previous sentence.)

source: After a pause, Lugano gathered his courage and inquired, “Will you be bringing Ludwig along in the future?”
target: Post mora, Lugano fortitudinem colligens interrogavit: “Num Ludwigum in futurum tecum afferes?”

source: “Of course,” Lumian replied, glancing sideways at Ludwig, who was devouring a roasted octopus.
target: «Certe,» respondit Lumian, ex latere intuitus ad Ludwigum, qui polypum assum edebat.

source: Had he not received the 0-01 information from the Church of Knowledge, he wouldn’t have considered keeping such a child around.
target: Nisi informationem 0-01 ab Ecclesia Scientiae acceperat, talem puerum retinere non cogitasset.

source: However, Ludwig had proven his usefulness.
target: Attamen, Ludwig utilitatem suam ostenderat.

source: In the future, he might serve as another Loki trap.
target: In futurum, fortasse ut aliud “Loki laqueum” fungatur.

source: Lugano swallowed and offered, “I can assist you in caring for Ludwig, so you won’t need to factor him in when dealing with matters—unlike how you could simply leave whenever you pleased in the past.”
target: Lugano deglutivit et proposuit: “Adiuvare te possum in Ludwig curando, ut eum in rebus non referas, prout antea quovis tempore discedere potuisti.”

source: As anticipated… Lumian wasn’t taken aback by Lugano’s proposal.
target: Ut praevidebatur… Lumian Lugani propositione non perterrefactus est.

source: He raised his chin slightly and inquired, “Reason?”
target: Levit paullo mentum et interrogavit: “Cur?”

source: Lugano smiled sheepishly and explained, “During this journey, I’ve witnessed much and faced attacks.
target: Lugano verecunde subrisit et explicavit: “Per hunc iter multa vidi et impetus subii.

source: It made me realize that Sequence 8s are still insignificant in the mysticism world.
target: Id me fecit intellegere quod sequence octo adhuc in mundo mysticae parva sunt.

source: They’re ill-equipped to handle risks.
target: Male instructi sunt ad pericula superanda.

source: Yes, if I return to Trier and discreetly wield my Doctor powers, I’ll undoubtedly attain middle-class status.
target: Ita, si ad Trier redeam et secretim potentias meae medicas adhibeam, certo statum mediocris assequemur.

source: It’s not inconceivable to ascend to high society, but I fear that garnering too much fame will draw the attention of official Beyonders.
target: Non impossibile est in societatem altam ascendere, sed timeo ne nimia fama attentionem officialium Beyonderorum attrahat.

source: Trier isn’t as lenient as Port Santa, which is more accommodating to wild Beyonders.
target: Trier non est tolerantior quam Portus Santa, qui Beyonderos feroces magis recipit.

source: Furthermore, those dangerous Beyonders are always lurking around us.
target: Praeterea, illi Beyonderi periculosi semper circa nos latent.

source: I refuse to be defenseless the next time I’m targeted.
target: Recuso esse sine defensione, si me iterum oppugnant.

source: “If you refrain from participating in mysticism gatherings and solely run a clinic as a doctor, you wouldn’t be entangled in dangerous affairs.
target: “Si a conventibus mysticis abstines et solum clinicam geras ut medicus, in rebus periculosis non implicaberis.

source: You could easily handle ordinary thieves and bandits,” Lumian countered nonchalantly.
target: Facile poteris fures et latrones comunes superare,” respondit Lumian leviter.

source: Lugano shook his head.
target: Lugano caput movit.

source: “The Beyonder who left me his relics, enabling me to become a Planter, once warned me that once I enter the mysticism world, escape is impossible.
target: “Beyonder, qui reliquias suas mihi reliquit, quibus plantator fieri potui, me olim monuit: “Cum in mundum mysticum ingredieris, evadere impossibile erit.

source: Beyonder incidents will always surround us.
target: Casus Beyonderorum semper nos circumvenient.

source: If I’m fortunate, I might survive until natural death, but if I’m unlucky, I’ll end up like him.
target: Si fortunatus fuerim, usque ad mortem naturalem superstes ero; sin infortunatus, eius sim.

source: At first, I didn’t fully believe it, but the events of the past six months have increasingly convinced me of its truth.
target: In initio non plene credidi, sed eventus sex mensium praeteritorum me veritati eius paulatim convincerunt.

source: I did nothing, yet Rue Anarchie collapsed, and a peculiar tree sprouted.
target: Nihil feci, attamen Rue Anarchie corruit et arbor insolita germinavit.

source: Before you hired me, I dreamed of becoming a figure in a painting, unable to return to reality.
target: Antequam me conducisti, somniavi me figuram in pictura fieri, quae re ad veritatem redire non posset.

source: Upon waking up, I found myself wanted.
target: Evigilans, me quaesitum esse reperi.

source: This time, all I did was care for Ludwig, staying clear of any involvement, yet I was still senselessly attacked…”
target: Hoc tempore, solum Ludwig curare me contuli, simul implicationum vitans, sed tamen insensate oppugnabar…

source: Mm… Lumian’s expression grew more peculiar as he listened.
target: Mmm… vultus Lumiani magis peculiaris factus est dum auscultabat.

source: I seem to be the common denominator in all your tales…
target: Videtur me esse communis elementum in omnibus tuis narratis…

source: Yet, you persist in following me…
target: Attamen, tu pertinacanter me sequeris…

source: Is this another instance of Beyonders encountering mysticism incidents? You didn’t encounter those incidents, but me…
target: Num haec iterum occasio est Beyonderorum mysticos casus experiendi? Tu non hos casus expertus es, sed me…

source: Lugano continued, “I’ve also witnessed Beyonder powers like teleportation and tsunamis.
target: Lugano continuavit: “Etiam vires Beyonderorum, sicut teleportatio et tsunami, perspexi.

source: Being just a Sequence 8 no longer satisfies me.
target: Solum esse sequence octo iam non me satiat.

source: I believe I’ll find more opportunities by following you.”
target: Credo me, te sequeris, plura opportunitates inveniturum esse.”

source: Lumian gazed at Lugano, unsure if someone had influenced him to insist on following or if Ludwig had somehow “tamed” him to be his “nanny.”
target: Lumian ad Lugano intuitus erat, incertus num aliquis eum ad te sequeris compelleret, aut num Ludwig eum aliquo modo “nutricem” fecisset.

source: Initially, Lumian thought Lugano, as a Beyonder of the Planter pathway, had ties to the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Initio, Lumian putavit Lugano, ut Beyonder viae Plantatoris, nexūs haberet cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

source: However, despite paying close attention, he hadn’t observed any additional communication between his guide and the Fertility Order or the Church of Earth Mother’s clergyman.
target: Attamen, quamvis diligenter aspiceret, nihil de communicatione inter ducem suum et Ordinem Fertilitatis nec sacerdotem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae animadvertit.

source: Furthermore, Lugano seemed like a stranger.
target: Praeterea, Lugano ut ignotus apparuit.

source: Seeing Lumian stay silent, Lugano smiled ingratiatingly and proposed, “I have a gift for languages.
target: Videns Lumian silentem manere, Lugano complacenter subrisit et proposuit: “Donum mihi est linguarum.

source: I can self-learn Dutanese from the Southern Continent.
target: Possum linguam Dutanensem ex Continente Australi ipse discere.

source: As long as you pay me 300 verl d’or a month and promise me a share of the spoils, I can continue to be your guide, private doctor, child caregiver, and be half a fighter.”
target: Dummodo mihi tribuscenta verl d’or per mensem praestes et partem praediorum mihi promittas, possum pergere ut dux tuus, medicus privatus, puerorum curator, atque dimidius pugnator tibi sim.

source: “Sure.” Lumian handed over a total of 10,000 verl d’or.
target: «Ita,» Lumian totaliter decem milia verl d’or tradidit.

source: “This is the final 5,000 verl d’or from before.
target: Haec sunt ultima quinque milia verl d’or ex praeterito tempore.

source: Additionally, you were attacked.
target: Praeterea, te oppugnatum est.

source: As per our agreement, I’ll pay you an extra 5,000 verl d’or, making it a total of 10,000.”
target: Secundum conventum nostrum, additos tibi quinque milia verl d’or solvam, ut in summa decem milia verl d’or habeas.

source: Lugano gladly accepted the payment and began packing.
target: Lugano laete solutionem accepit et coepit sarcinas parare.

source: Lumian seized the moment to count his cash, confirming he still possessed 1,000 verl d’or in gold, 76,000 verl d’or in gold coins, along with other coins, banknotes, and the remaining 2,000 gold risot yet to be spent.
target: Lumian occasionem sumpsit numerare pecuniam suam, confirmans se adhuc possidere 1,000 verl d’or ex auro, 76,000 verl d’or in nummis aureis, necnon alias monetas, chartas monetarias, et reliqua 2,000 risot auri nondum expensa.

source: As long as he refrained from acquiring Beyonder characteristics, potion formulas, mystical items, or high-end mysticism knowledge, the money he carried could sustain him for a considerable time.
target: Dummodo se abstineat a proprietatibus Beyonder, formulae potionum, rebus mysticis, aut scientia mystica summi gradus, pecunia quam gerebat eum diuturno tempore sufficere poterat.

source: The following morning, Lumian boarded the ship bound for Feynapotter, adopting the guise of the adventurer Louis Berry.
target: Mane sequenti, Lumian navigio ad Feynapotter conscendit, sub persona adventoris Ludovici Berry.

source: Approaching the first-class suite, he turned to Ludwig, posing a thoughtful question, “In your memories, or rather, Loki’s memories, are there any peculiar creatures?
target: Accedens ad cellam primae classis, ad Ludwig se vertit, quaestionem consideratam proponens: “Num in memoriis tuis, aut potius in memoriis Loki, quaedam creaturae insolitae sunt?

source: They resemble lizards but are quite small.
target: Sunt similes lacertis, sed satis parvi sunt.

source: They can crawl into a human’s mouth, appearing transparent and blurry, suspected to be Spirit Body.
target: In os hominum repere possunt, apparentes translucidis et confusis, suspicati corpus spiritale esse.

source: They have brownish-green scales and dark-green eyes.
target: Habent squamas brunneo-virides et oculos virides obscuros.

source: This description deviated significantly from the Starlight Lizards transformed by the Children of the Sea.
target: Haec descriptio signanter differebat ab “Starlight Lizards” a Pueris Maris transformatis.

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludwig caput movit.

source: “No, it’s not in the Batings Black Insect’s memories either.”
target: «Non, id neque in memoriis “Batings Black Insect” est.»

source: Lumian fell silent, observing Lugano as he opened the suite door with the mannerisms of a servant.
target: Lumian tacuit, observans Lugano ostium cellae cum moribus ministrorum aperire.

source: Another hour passed, and amidst a whistle, the ship departed Port Santa.
target: Altera hora peracta, et inter sibilum, navis Portum Santa reliquit.

source: After nearly two hours of sailing, the weather gradually worsened.
target: Post fere duas horas navigandi, tempestas paulatim deteriorata est.

source: The waves surged, and the strong winds compelled passengers on the deck to retreat to their cabins.
target: Fluctus vehementer surrexerunt, et venti validi vectōs in ponte ad cellas suas recedere coegerunt.

source: Observing the dusky sky, the dark clouds stirred by the wind, and the rising waves, many passengers, sailing for the first time, felt a sense of anxiety.
target: Observantes caelum obscurum, nubila obscura vento motata, et fluctus ascendentes, multi vectōs, primum navigantes, anxietatem senserunt.

source: Noticing the confidence of the sailors beside them, they sought reassurance, “This is a common occurrence at sea. It’s not dangerous, right?”
target: Animadvertentes fiduciam nautarum adstantes, quaesiverunt solacium: “Hoc res in mari commune est. Non periculosum, nonne?”

source: A Port Santa native, working as a sailor, replied with a smile, “It’s relatively common, but it can be a bit dangerous.
target: Indigenus Portus Santa, qui nauta erat, subrisus respondit: “Relativum commune est, sed aliquantum periculosum esse potest.

source: If the storm intensifies, we might need to seek shelter in a nearby port.
target: Si tempestas augebitur, fortasse in portu proximo asylum quaerendum erit.

source: But don’t worry.
target: Sed noli solliciti esse.

source: This year’s sea prayer ritual was a success.
target: Ritus orationis maritimae huius anni successit.

source: The current Governor of the Sea will protect us and prevent any shipwrecks!”
target: Praefectus Maris hodiernus nos proteget et naufragia impediat!”

source: Governor of the Sea… The passengers became even more uneasy upon hearing the sailor’s response.
target: Praefectus Maris… Vectōs, audito responsu nautae, etiam magis turbati sunt.

source: They had taken part in various sea prayer rituals and celebrations in Port Santa.
target: Participaverunt variis ritibus orationis maritimae et celebrationibus in Portu Santa.

source: While enjoyable, they didn’t truly believe that the Governor of the Sea could exert any significant influence on the waves.
target: Quamquam iucunda, verum non crediderunt Praefectum Maris fluctus regere posse.

source: Amidst their unease, they were astonished to find that the rising waves suddenly subsided.
target: In medio eorum sollicitudinum, stupuerunt invenientes fluctus ascendentes subito quieti factos esse.

source: Despite the dark clouds and strong winds, the seawater seemed to be pressed down by an invisible force, showing no noticeable fluctuations.
target: Non obstante nubibus obscuris et ventis validis, aquae maris videbatur vi invisibili pressa esse, nec fluctuationes apparentes ostendens.

source: The Port Santa natives erupted in cheers.
target: Indigeni Portus Santa plausu acclamaverunt.

source: “Long live the Governor! Praise the Governor of the Sea!”
target: «Vivat Praefectus! Laudate Praefectum Maris!»

source: Witnessing this, the passengers exchanged glances, momentarily speechless.
target: Id videntes, vectōs se mutuo aspexerunt, per momentum loquela carentes.

source: In the first-class suite, Lumian relaxed in a recliner, sipping undiluted Manzan.
target: In cella primae classis, Lumian in sessili quiescebat, libens Manzan indivisum.

source: On his lap lay a Southern Continent Dutanese introductory textbook.
target: In gremio eius iacebat liber introductorius linguae Dutanensis ex Continente Australi.

source: Clenching his right hand into a fist, he pulled it downward.
target: Manum dextram in pugno cohibens, eam deorsum traxit.

source: A section of the dark clouds in the sky descended, forming a formidable funnel.
target: Pars nubium obscurarum in caelo descendit, infundibulum formans.

source: Sunlight penetrated the massive hole, brightening the cabin and highlighting Lumian’s book.
target: Lumen solis per ingentem hiatus penetrauit, cellam illustrans et librum Lumiani evidenter ostendens.

source: Retracting his right hand, Lumian flipped through a page of the book.
target: Manum dextram retractans, Lumian paginam libri volvit.

source: He found the Governor of the Sea’s abilities truly advantageous at sea.
target: Invenit virtutes Praefecti Maris vere utilissimas esse in mari.

source: Unfortunately, he could only use it for one more day.
target: Infeliciter, id solum ad unum diem usurpari poterat.

source: Late at night in Trier, Angoulême returned to his residence and habitually switched on the radio transceiver.
target: Sero nocte in Trier, Angoulême ad domum suam rediit et more solito radiotransmissorem activavit.

source: Before long, a telegram arrived.
target: Mox telegramma advenit.

source: Upon seeing “Hidden Blade,” Angoulême frowned.
target: Videns “Hidden Blade,” Angoulême fronem contraxit.

source: “Two bits of good news and a spot of bad news. Which one do you want first?
target: «Dua bona nuntia et unum malum. Quid primum audire vis?

source: “I know. You must want to hear the good news first. I’ll get straight to it.
target: «Scio. Primum nuntia bona audire cupis. Iam ad rem me conferam.

source: The first piece of good news is that the humanoid Sealed Artifact has been located and secured.
target: «Primum nuntium bonum est quod Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide repertum et securum factum est.

source: You don’t have to worry about the business trip to Feynapotter.
target: Negotium itineris ad Feynapotter te non sollicitandum erit.

source: You can focus on investigating the Mirror People matter in peace.
target: Potes in pace rem Populi Specularum investigare.

source: The second piece of good news is that after communication, we’ve confirmed that the faction controlling the humanoid Sealed Artifact might return it to you.
target: «Secundum nuntium bonum est quod, post communicationem, confirmavimus factionem, quae Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide regit, id tibi reddi posse.

source: We’re willing to facilitate the matter, but you’ll need to provide all the information about the humanoid Sealed Artifact in exchange.
target: Parati sumus rem hanc facilitare, sed oportet ut omnes notitias de Artifacto Sigillato tradas in commutatione.

source: Of course, it’s just a possibility, nothing set in stone.
target: Scilicet, sola possibilitas est, nihil tamen definitum.

source: You won’t need to make a substantial payment until we reach an agreement.
target: Non necesse erit tibi solutionem magnam facere, donec consensus pervenerit.

source: Bad news. Heh heh, there’s a traitor in your Church.
target: Nuntium malum: Heh heh, in Ecclesia tua est proditor.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact was lost because of a mole!
target: Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide ob talpam amisum est!

source: We’re certain of this.
target: Haec certo scimus.

source: “Go, 007. Your chance to render meritorious service has arrived!”
target: «Vade, 007. Tempus tuum ad officium meritorium praebeandum advenit!»

source: After reading it in one go, Angoulême felt a sense of relief.
target: Id totum uno lecto, Angoulême levamen sensit.

source: This was because after the humanoid Sealed Artifact was lost, the Church’s upper echelons suspected a traitor and conducted an investigation, but to no avail.
target: Hoc enim evenit, quia postquam Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide amissum erat, summae Ecclesiae proditorem suspicati sunt atque inquisitionem egerunt, sed frustra.

source: There was indeed an issue with the case leading to the loss of the humanoid Sealed Artifact, but the five Purifiers in charge of that case had been cleared of any wrongdoing during the investigation.
target: Verum quaestio in casu, qui ad amissionem Artifacti Sigillati humanoide duxit, exstabat, sed quinque Purificatores huius casus in inquisitione ab omni scelere absoluti sunt.

source: They hadn’t performed well back then and had merely encountered an accident.
target: Illi tunc non bene perfuerant et solum casu incidere evenit.

source: It seems that the mole has concealed himself well… Angoulême muttered to himself.
target: Videtur talpa se bene celaverit… Angoulême sibi ipsi submurmuravit.

source: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai.

source: Franca sat by the bed and chatted in the telegram group, waiting for Jenna to return.
target: Franca iuxta lectum sedebat et in coetu telegraphii colloquia agebat, exspectans ut Jenna rediret.

source: Her female companion would visit the Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra once a week to watch a theater performance and only return at midnight.
target: Comitissa eius, femina, semel in hebdomada Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra visitaret ut spectaculum theatralem spectaret, atque solum media nocte rediret.

source: However, the exact day she went was uncertain.
target: Attamen, dies quo illa ivisset, incertus erat.

source: Furthermore, she would disguise herself to prevent others from noticing her travel patterns.
target: Praeterea, se celare solebat, ne alii itinerum eius consuetudinem animadverterent.

source: Anthony, who lived nearby, had been busy infiltrating a circle of psychology enthusiasts, hoping to come into contact with a true Psychiatrist.
target: Anthony, qui vicinique habitabat, circulum studiorum psychologiae infiltrabat, sperans ad verum Psychiatram pervenire.

source: I seem to be the only one with time on my hands. I haven’t received any feedback about Mirror People…
target: Videtur me solum esse qui tempus habeat. Responsum de Populo Specularum non accepi…

source: Franca wasn’t the kind of person who insisted on having something on her hands. She excelled in finding joy in life.
target: Franca non erat talis persona, quae constanter aliquid in manu tenere vellet. Illa in vita laetitiam reperire praeclare utebatur.

source: While Franca thought about Jenna, Jenna—who had just finished watching the last play—put on a hat with a black veil and stood up to leave the theater, where many spectators were still lingering.
target: Dum Franca de Jenna cogitabat, Jenna—quae nuper ultimam fabulam spectaverat—pileum cum velamine nigro induit et surrexit theatrum relinquere, ubi multi spectatores adhuc morabantur.

source: At the exit, she patiently queued up and moved out.
target: Ad exitum, patienter in ordinem se collocavit, et discessit.

source: Suddenly, Jenna sensed a slight tremor from one of the items on her.
target: Subito, Jenna levem tremorem ex una rerum quae in ea erant sensit.

source: Instinctively, she reached in and realized that it was the Mirror World Fragment from the Tamara family’s tomb.
target: Instinctu, intulit manum et animadvertit id esse Fragmentum Mundi Specularis ex sepulcro familiae Tamarae.
